title: Daily Service Status Bulletin
summary: Morning status bulletin published by the operations centre for the public status page and partner integrations.

sections.heading: Service summary
paragraphs: All customer-facing services were operating normally at the 07:30 check. No incidents are open, and the overnight maintenance window closed on schedule at 05:10.
The public status line for partner integrations is the single sentence in the excerpt below. Partners collect it through the status collector endpoint.

sections.heading: Distribution
paragraphs: Published to status.calderbrook.example and the partner status collector. No customer or account data is included in this bulletin.
